title: check: migratedFrom format and duplicate-fingerprint flag (D3)
description: Core git-vouch change: validate migratedFrom = 'openpgp4fpr:' + 40 uppercase/lowercase hex; flag (report, per D3) any fingerprint claimed by more than one handle. String comparison only; git-vouch never runs gpg.
acceptance_criteria: Tests: bad format rejected; two handles with one fingerprint both flagged; check output names both.
notes: Implemented (A2-core): git-vouch _person validates migratedFrom (openpgp4fpr: lowercase prefix + 40 hex either case; null = absent; bad value = check problem); Person.migrated_from holds uppercase fpr; check_registry warns (non-failing) on each valid person file whose fpr another also claims. Review fixes: git-vouch-migrate verify-continuity maps check problems 'people/<h>.json: migratedFrom...' to failed[h] (core rejection hid the handle; tests/migrate passes again); test for register --from refusing a malformed draft. Open question: should a historical person-file version that fails strict parsing break continuity (warn) rather than reset it? Pre-existing for every field; no live registry predates migratedFrom, so not exploitable now.
